cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've calculated the optimal move in this raffle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You buy a ticket. That's all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Timing is crucial. Tell me when to buy; I'll have the money ready.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you pick my ticket. I'll let the shuffle distribute my advantage.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 gives B purchase timing and A5 ticket choice while maintaining an improvised odds claim.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 simple purchase becomes A3 timing strategy; B4 shuffling becomes delegated choice.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 explain the ordinary raffle mechanics that A pretends to master.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 shuffle to surrender choice while claiming an advantage anyway.

specificity.evidence: A1 raffle, B2 ticket and B4 shuffle are coherent.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 distribute my advantage is abstract probability language that explains the bluff rather than persuades B.
